findings.title: 'We hacked the FBI:' Hackers say they have data on all FBI employees
findings.summary_md: 404 Media broke the story of the breach hours before the FBI comment cycle began. ShinyHunters claimed it hacked the FBI and holds data on almost all FBI employees and individuals who applied for a job with the bureau. A sample of 5,000 alleged agents reviewed by 404 Media included names, addresses, phone numbers, and details on employees' spouses.

findings.title: Hacking group ShinyHunters claims it breached the FBI, stole agents' and applicants' data
findings.summary_md: TechCrunch reported that ShinyHunters claimed it breached the FBI and stole data on agents and applicants after temporarily defacing the FBI jobs site. The report followed 404 Media's initial disclosure by roughly two hours on the same day.

findings.title: ShinyHunters hacks Clop leak site, threatens to extort ransomware gang
findings.summary_md: Three days before the FBI breach, ShinyHunters defaced the Clop ransomware operation's data leak site on Tor and claimed it stole server data and the private keys for the site's onion service, threatening to extort the rival gang. The incident shows the group was already in an open feud and a spectacle-seeking posture in the days before it targeted the FBI.
